data.tourName: UJJAIN – MAHESHWAR – OMKARESHWAR TOURPACKAGE - 2 NIGHTS 3 DAYS ( 5 Days Inclusive2 Days Train Journey )
data.overview:
Two Jyotirlingas – Mahakaleshwar & Omkareshwar
Historic Maheshwar – Ahilya Bai Holkar Fort
data.dayDesc1: Departure from Ichalkaranji By Travels At 5.30 AM to Pune. Reach Pune at 11.30AM , Nexttrain from Pune to Ujjain Train No. 22943 at 15.30 PM Overnight Train Journey
data.dayDesc2:
Arrival at Ujjain Railway Station at 06:30 AM. On arrival transfer to hotel by Local Auto..
Check-in at hotel, freshen up and proceed to City tour by Auto.
Visit:
Shri Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga Temple
Harsiddhi Mata Temple
Kal Bhairav Temple
data.dayDesc3:
Morning after breakfast, check-out from the hotel and proceed for Maheshwar by CAR.
📍 Distance: 175 km | ⏱ Travel Time: 4 hrs (approx.)
On arrival at Maheshwar, visit:
Ahilya Bai Holkar Fort
Ahilya Mata’s Cenotaph (Chhatri)
Baneshwar Mahadev Temple
Maheshwar → Omkareshwar
📍 Distance: 65 km | ⏱ Travel Time: 2 hrs (approx.)
On arrival, check-in at hotel.
Overnight stay at Omkareswar.
data.dayDesc4:
After Breakfast, proceed for Omkareshwar sightseeing.
Visit:
Shri Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga Temple
Mamleshwar (Amreshwar) Temple
Narmada Ghat / Short Parikrama
Omkareshwar → Khandwa Railway Station
📍 Distance: 75 km | ⏱ Travel Time: 2 hrs (approx.)
Drop at Khandwa Railway Station at 07:00 PM Departure from Khandwa by TrainNo.12782-NZM MYS SF EXP at 8.00 PM to Miraj.
data.dayDesc5: Reach Miraj at 12.45 PM . Tour Ends with Beautiful Memories of Ujjain and Omkareswar.
